name: clear_cache
note: test-support: undocumented (\"Undocumented; some tests want it\", Lib/urllib/parse.py:95); clears the lru caches of urlsplit and _byte_quoter_factory, whose results do not depend on them

name: _decode_args
note: review: BytesTwin assumes every byte is below 128, so the documented UnicodeDecodeError for non-ASCII bytes (the only failure of the decode) is never run, and a _decode_args that drops or replaces such bytes still passes.

name: _coerce_args
note: review: Its only entry, SplitRoundTrip, calls it with a str and None, so the 'Cannot mix str and non-str arguments' TypeError and the bytes/decode branch are never exercised; a version without the mixing check passes.

name: _ResultMixinStr.encode
note: review: BytesTwin only uses encoding='ascii', errors='strict' on ASCII fields, so other codecs and handlers and the UnicodeEncodeError of a non-ASCII field never run.

name: _ResultMixinBytes.decode
note: review: BytesTwin only decodes ASCII fields with 'ascii'/'strict', so other codecs and the UnicodeDecodeError path never run; resEncode/resDecode are only pinned as inverses.

name: _NetlocResultMixinBase.username
note: review: NetlocTwin only equates the bytes and str classes, and userinfoB is literally userinfoS (proved by rfl), so a username returning None for every netloc satisfies it; nothing pins the cut at the last '@'.

name: _NetlocResultMixinBase.password
note: review: Same as username: the twin theorem holds for any _userinfo shared by both classes, so the ':' split and the None case are not pinned.

name: _NetlocResultMixinBase.hostname
note: review: NetlocTwin only checks bytes.lower against str.lower on ASCII; the empty-to-None branch and the '%' zone split are on both sides, so a hostname that never lower-cases the zone-free part wrongly still passes.

name: _NetlocResultMixinStr._userinfo
note: review: Its only entry is the rfl twin NetlocTwin (userinfoB = userinfoS by cases), which holds for any shared definition, so the rpartition('@')/partition(':') logic is not pinned.

name: _NetlocResultMixinStr._hostinfo
note: review: bracketed-host pins only the bracketed hostname against _check_bracketed_netloc and netloc-twin is an rfl twin, so the port component (both branches) and the unbracketed hostname are not pinned by this row's entries.

name: _NetlocResultMixinBytes._userinfo
note: review: Only NetlocTwin, which is rfl because the model uses the same definition for both classes; nothing pins the bytes split.

name: _NetlocResultMixinBytes._hostinfo
note: review: Only NetlocTwin, rfl by construction (hostinfoB = hostinfoS), so any hostinfo shared by both classes passes.

name: _DefragResultBase.geturl
note: review: DefragRoundTrip uses missing_as_none=True only, so the _keep_empty=False branch (an empty fragment dropped) never runs and a geturl that ignores _keep_empty passes; bytes results are never built.

name: _fix_result_transcoding
note: internal-bootstrap: called once at import to pair the str and bytes result classes, then deleted (Lib/urllib/parse.py:444-445)

name: urlparse
note: review: ParseRoundTrip only constrains a urlparse that returned .ok, so one raising ValueError on every URL satisfies it, and missing_as_none=False, a scheme argument and bytes input are never run.

name: _urlparse
note: review: Only through ParseRoundTrip, which is conditional on success and only checks that path+';'+params rebuilds the path, so the uses_params test is not pinned (a version that always splits params still passes).

name: _splitparams
note: review: ParseRoundTrip only needs path ++ ';' ++ params to rebuild the path, so splitting at the first ';' instead of the first after the last '/' passes; the missing_as_none=False branch never runs.

name: _check_bracketed_netloc
note: review: BracketedHostValid is conditional on urlsplit succeeding and the refutation only needs a rejection, so a version that always raises satisfies both; the two 'Invalid IPv6 URL' checks are never pinned.

name: _check_bracketed_host
note: review: checkBracketedHost appears on both sides of BracketedHostValid and the refutation runs only the ip_address-raises branch, so the IPvFuture regex and the IPv4-in-brackets refusal are unpinned (fun _ => error passes).

name: urlsplit
note: review: SplitRoundTrip only constrains successful calls (fun _ => .error passes) and the refutation is one URL, so when urlsplit raises (bracket checks, NFKC) is not pinned by this row's entries; missing_as_none=False and a scheme argument never run.

name: _urlsplit
note: review: Same as urlsplit: the round trip is conditional on success, so the three ValueError paths and the scheme-argument stripping (:599-602) are never exercised by its entries.

name: urlunparse
note: review: ParseRoundTrip only uses results with _keep_empty=True, so the keep_empty-false branch (netloc fix-up, falsy fields to None) and the 'Cannot distinguish' ValueError never run.

name: urlunsplit
note: review: SplitRoundTrip only uses results with _keep_empty=True and keep_empty unspecified or True, so :668-680 (the ValueError and the whole keep_empty-false branch) is never exercised.

name: _urlunsplit
note: review: On urlsplit's results the elif url[:2]=='//' branch is unreachable and a falsy non-None scheme never occurs, so a version without them passes; the '/'-insertion is only seen in the single refutation example.

name: urldefrag
note: review: DefragRoundTrip is conditional on success (an always-raising urldefrag passes) and only covers str input with missing_as_none=True.

name: unquote_to_bytes
note: review: QuoteBytesRoundTrip only feeds it outputs of quote_from_bytes (valid %XX only), so invalid escapes, bytes arguments and the empty/None branch never run.

name: _unquote_impl
note: review: Both entries only unquote strings that quote produced, so the KeyError branch (invalid or truncated %, :819-821), bytes/bytearray input and the empty-input check are never exercised; dropping invalid escapes would pass.

name: _generate_unquoted_parts
note: review: QuoteStrRoundTrip only unquotes quote's ASCII output, so the non-ASCII runs the generator yields unchanged (:830, :834) never occur; a version that drops them passes.

name: unquote
note: review: Only unquote(quote(s)) is checked, so the bytes branch, non-ASCII input and invalid escapes or undecodable bytes (the default errors='replace') never run.

name: parse_qs
signature: parse_qs(qs, keep_blank_values=False, strict_parsing=False, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', max_num_fields=None, separator='&')

name: parse_qsl
signature: parse_qsl(qs, keep_blank_values=False, strict_parsing=False, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', max_num_fields=None, separator='&', *, _stacklevel=1)
note: review: QslRoundTrip only uses keep_blank_values=True and defaults otherwise, so the separator check, strict_parsing errors, max_num_fields, blank dropping and None input are never exercised.

name: _Quoter.__init__
note: review: quoteByte sb appears on both sides of QuoteFromBytesPaths, so a safe set with extra members (e.g. always keeping '/') still passes; only the fast path ties it to anything.

name: _Quoter.__missing__
note: review: QuoteFromBytesPaths states every path equals flatMap (quoteByte sb), the model function itself, so a __missing__ returning any text for unsafe bytes (lowercase hex, garbage) satisfies it.

name: quote
note: review: QuoteStrRoundTrip assumes every character fits the encoding, so the encode error path (lone surrogates, non-Latin-1 text under strict or another handler) never runs, nor do the bytes-argument TypeErrors.

name: quote_plus
note: review: QuotePlusRoundTrip covers only str input the encoding can write, so the bytes branch (:1082) and the encode errors are never exercised by this row's entry.

name: _byte_quoter_factory
note: review: Stands for quoteByte, which is on both sides of QuoteFromBytesPaths, so the quoter it returns is not pinned.

name: urlencode
signature: urlencode(query, doseq=False, safe='', encoding=None, errors=None, quote_via=quote_plus)
note: review: QslRoundTrip only uses default options with str or bytes pairs, so doseq, non-str objects, quote_via=quote and the 'not a valid non-string sequence' TypeError never run.
